title: Spring Picnic Lunch in the Park
texts: 【Memory Story】Spring Picnic Lunch in the Park
A quiet spring afternoon. I had a little time to spare while I was out on rounds.
Wakaba Central Park is close by. Maybe I'll stop in for a break.
Soft spring sunlight streamed into the park.
Cherry blossom petals drifted slowly on the breeze.
As I headed toward the plaza lined with benches, a familiar head of red hair caught my eye.
Oh, Manager! Good work today!
Hi, Hina. I didn't expect to run into you here. Lunch break?
Yep! The weather was so nice today, I thought I'd eat my lunch outside.
I see. Lunch in the park, huh? Nice.
A lunch box sat open on a cloth across Hina's lap.
Did you make that yourself?
Of course! I may not look it, but I'm actually pretty good at cooking, you know?
Wow... that looks good.
Hehe. Then... want to try a bite?
Really? I can?
Sure! It's just a little hamburger steak, but I'm confident about the taste!
With her red chopsticks, Hina cut off a bite-sized piece of hamburger steak and held it out to me with a slightly bashful look.
Here, Manager. Say 'aaah'...
...Thanks. Don't mind if I do.
The sweet and savory aroma of the sauce spread gently. With one bite, the rich flavor of the meat blended perfectly with the mild seasoning.
...That's good. Did you really make this, Hina?
I really did! Come on, that's not the part you're supposed to doubt!
No, I'm genuinely impressed. This is seriously good.
Hehe... if you praise me that much, you're going to make me blush.
With cooking like this, you'd make a great wife someday.
Huh...?
Hina's face turned bright red in an instant.
M-me... a wife?!
I-I should get back now!
What? You're leaving already?
Y-yes! See you back at the store!
Hina hurriedly packed up her lunch and trotted out of the park.
...Why did she suddenly get so flustered?
The spring breeze played with the petals, gently carrying away the commotion from a moment ago.
For a while, only the spring sunlight left on the bench and the taste of hamburger steak lingered in the Manager's memory.
【Added to Memories】Hina: “Spring Picnic Lunch in the Park”
